title: Dragons Add-On
description: A full-featured dragons add-on bringing fearsome dragon entities to Minecraft Bedrock. Worked on entity behaviors, custom animations, and art assets.

title: Be a Mob
alt: Be a Mob add-on for Minecraft Bedrock
description: A unique add-on letting players transform into and play as mobs. Led the project end-to-end as sole developer and project lead, handling all technical systems and design decisions.

title: Mutants Add-On
description: Brings mutant variants of classic Minecraft mobs with overhauled behaviors, attacks, and animations. Contributed as developer and artist across the full add-on.

title: Into The Wild
alt: Into The Wild add-on for Minecraft Bedrock
description: A nature-focused add-on expanding the wildlife and ecosystem of Minecraft Bedrock with new creatures, behaviors, and environments.

title: Backrooms Add-On
description: A horror-themed add-on recreating the Backrooms experience in Minecraft Bedrock, complete with eerie environments, custom entities, and unsettling atmosphere.

title: Weapons Expansion
description: An extensive weapons add-on adding a wide variety of new armaments to Minecraft Bedrock. Contributed as asset creator and art director, overseeing visual quality and consistency.

title: Survival+
description: A comprehensive survival overhaul add-on expanding and deepening the core Minecraft Bedrock experience with new mechanics, items, and content.

title: Survival+ Demons
description: A dark expansion to the Survival+ add-on introducing demonic entities, infernal environments, and challenging new encounters.

title: Weapons Expansion 3
description: The third installment of the Weapons Expansion series, pushing the visual and technical bar further with new armaments and refined assets.
